author: GameSpot
description:
Watch us fight though 27 layers of a later game dungeon in Stupid Never Dies with Go Nuts Mode turned on. You play as a Zombie who can "Style Eat" enemies and gain their abilities after turning into them. 

You'll get to see multiple environments and watch us play as a good number of monsters while leveling up and becoming strong enough to even one shot some bosses.
